test_sha_fileobj: test the sha_fileobj function computes SHA-256 digest from file objects and BytesIO streams
test_git_hash: test the git_hash function produces output matching git hash-object for blob objects
create_sha_fileobj_file: create a SHA-256 digest from a binary file using sha_fileobj with a file handle
create_sha_fileobj_memory: create a SHA-256 digest from in-memory bytes using sha_fileobj with BytesIO
create_git_hash_blob: create a git-compatible hash for blob content using git_hash with raw bytes
